title: A.e. strongly measurable maps into L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P) are a.e. measurable for its Borel σ-algebra
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let μ be any measure on ℝ^P (Borel σ-algebra). Let f : ℝ^P → L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P) be a map into the space of continuous linear endomorphisms of ℝ^P, equipped with the operator-norm topology and its Borel σ-algebra (Mathlib's ContinuousLinearMap.instMeasurableSpace, which is borel). If f is almost-everywhere strongly measurable with respect to μ (AEStronglyMeasurable f μ), then f is almost-everywhere measurable with respect to μ (AEMeasurable f μ).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → (Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P)), AEStronglyMeasurable f μ → AEMeasurable f μ
